title: It is time to give up the dualism introduced by the debate on consciousness
summary: A philosophical article from Noema Magazine arguing that the consciousness debate has introduced an unhelpful dualism that should be abandoned. The piece challenges the 'hard problem of consciousness' framework and suggests moving toward more integrated approaches to understanding consciousness.
problem_solved: Addresses the philosophical problem of how consciousness studies have created artificial divisions between mind and body, or subjective and objective perspectives.
why_valuable: Offers a reframe for consciousness studies that could lead to more productive research directions by abandoning conceptual divisions that may be self-imposed.
